text:
tara: FYI I hit a weird parity thing between the Node & Py SDKs when integrating embeddings+rerank in the new sample app.

kevin: detail?

tara: Node's batching helper wraps single-item batches as [[...vector...]] while Python returns [...vector...]. That causes our downstream retriever to think each embedding is multi-vector and blow up shapes.

li: Oof. Any repro? logs? 

tara: Minimal repro below (abbreviated):

```
// Node
const b = makeBatch([{text: 'q'}])
// b => [ [0.12, 0.03, ...] ]

// Python
b = make_batch(['q'])
# b => [0.12, 0.03, ...]
```

sierra: I also noticed hosted rerank responses sometimes return "ranking_score" and sometimes "score" depending on model version. We map to score in the SDK and it's brittle.

rahul: Also observed duplicate side-effects when auth middleware retries on 401: retried request lacks x-rw-client-id, so server handles twice.

tara: Workaround I pushed to local sampleapp: normalize embeddings to ensure list-of-list and do score fallback mapping.

```
// normalize
let vecs = resp.data
if (!Array.isArray(vecs[0])) vecs = [vecs]

// score map
const s = r.score ?? r.ranking_score ?? r.conf
```

kevin: Proposed fixes:
- Node batching helper: ensure consistent return shape for n=1 (wrap only vectors as list-of-list when API expects it) — PR incoming.
- SDK mapping layer: accept both score and ranking_score.
- Auth: preserve client idempotency header across retries or only refresh token without re-sending body.

platform-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-2555: "SDK parity: embedding batch shape + rerank score key + auth retry idempotency". Linked PRs: prs/7001 (node batching), prs/7002 (sdk score mapping), prs/7003 (auth retry header retain). Added request: add e2e test in sampleapp asserting identical normalized outputs between Node & Py.

sierra: Can someone add a note to the onboarding docs that sampleapp expects normalized embeddings and that rerank field may vary by model? New users will hit this.

rahul: I'll add a short blurb + snippet in docs/docs_onboarding.md and a sample unit test in sampleapp/tests/e2e_parity.test.js

tara: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll wait for PRs and will update sampleapp template when merged. :party_parrot:
